sources.excerpt: Fuzzrocious Pedals BABY FURNACE | AllThePedals Articles Genealogy Browse Search results for " " Gain / Fuzz / Fuzzrocious Pedals BABY FURNACE BABY FURNACE The Fuzzrocious Baby Furnace is a mini, ripping, gated fuzz pedal based on the BLAST FURNACE. It offers two footswitches for on/off and switching between two volume settings, one with a wide-open fuzz, and the other with a tone control for shaping the fuzz from bright to dark. A blend control allows mixing of clean signal or an overdrive for added versatility. What Fuzzrocious Pedals say about the BABY FURNACE What is BABY FURNACE? BABY FURNACE is the mini version touting just the ripping, gated fuzz section of our BLAST FURNACE. The right footswitch turns the pedal on/off. The left footswitch allows the user to switch between whether Volume 1 or Volume 2 is active. When Volume 1 is active, the fuzz signal is wide open with a full frequency blast. When Volume 2 is active, the Tone pot is now active, allowing one to change the tone sweep of the fuzz. The Tone pot moves from angry wasps in an Orange Crush can through drug rug over the cab doom with many, many sweet spots in between. We’ve added a Blend pot so you can add in your clean (dry) signal from your instrument and/or any pedals you place before Baby Furnace (ex – blending an overdrive into the Baby Furnace signal). fuzzrociouspedals.com BABY FURNACE compared to ...
